description_en: Queries the number of assets that are assigned public IP addresses in abnormal states and the number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances that are about to expire in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下，状态异常的公网IP资产的数量和即将过期的DDoS原生防护实例的数量
name: DescribeExcpetionCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

ExceptionIpCount.description_en: The number of abnormal IP addresses (such as those in the Black Hole Activated state) among protected assets that are assigned public IP addresses (such as a cloud server ECS instance, a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance, and an elastic IP address (EIP))
ExceptionIpCount.description_zh: 受保护公网IP资产（云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例等）中，状态异常的IP（例如，处于黑洞中等）的数量

ExpireTimeCount.description_en: The number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances that are about to expire (with a remaining validity period of less than 7 days)
ExpireTimeCount.description_zh: 即将到期（剩余有效期不足7天）的DDoS原生防护实例的数量
